text: Issuing non fungible reputation tokens that represent voting power, access rights, or entitlement to a share of the project's success creates an economic structure in which participants are directly invested in the success of the RLHF process.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607

isBasedOn.name: How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance

abstract: The web3 system as proposed herein can issue non-fungible reputation tokens that represent voting power, access rights, or entitlement to a share of the project's success. This creates an economic structure where participants are directly invested in the success of the RLHF process
